title: Harden sshd logins
description: Specimens got in with a guessed password. Turning off password logins and root logins means guessed passwords no longer work; use SSH keys.
content:
# Disable password and root logins over SSH
sed -i -E 's/^#?PasswordAuthentication .*/PasswordAuthentication no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config
sed -i -E 's/^#?PermitRootLogin .*/PermitRootLogin no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config
# Reload with: systemctl reload sshd

title: Block outbound mining port 3333
description: Specimens tried to reach a cryptocurrency mining pool on this port. Blocking outbound traffic to it stops a miner from working.
content:
# Drop outbound TCP traffic to port 3333
iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp --dport 3333 -j DROP
